    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Roslyn语法的模式匹配之EasySyntax增加模式匹配支持</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        使用Roslyn语法生成包含模式匹配的代码
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一先看一个模式匹配的case">一、先看一个模式匹配的Case</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该Case是一个使用模式匹配检测回文算法,只有一行代码</li>
<li>这是不是你见过最简洁的检测回文代码</li>
<li>但是这里面用到了不少模式匹配</li>
<li>有逻辑模式、列表模式、var模式和切片模式</li>
<li>模式匹配不仅仅是语法糖,在.net中有很高的地位</li>
<li>所以SourceGenerator非常有必要支持生成模式匹配的代码</li>
<li>为此开源项目EasySyntax全面增加模式匹配的支持</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public static bool IsPalindrome(ReadOnlySpan&lt;char&gt; input)
    =&gt; input is not [var first, ..var middle, var last] || (first == last &amp;&amp; IsPalindrome(middle));
</code></pre>
<h2 id="二-模式匹配的主要类型">二、 模式匹配的主要类型</h2>
<h3 id="1-类型模式">1. 类型模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>检查表达式的运行时类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-声明模式">2. 声明模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>检查表达式的运行时类型，如果匹配成功，请将表达式结果分配给声明的变量</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-常量模式">3. 常量模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>测试表达式结果是否等于指定的常量</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="4-关系模式">4. 关系模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>将表达式结果与指定的常量进行比较</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="5-var模式">5. var模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>匹配任何表达式并将其结果分配给声明的变量</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="6-丢弃模式">6. 丢弃模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>也叫弃元模式</li>
<li>匹配任何表达式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="7-逻辑模式">7. 逻辑模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>测试表达式是否与模式的逻辑组合匹配</li>
<li>通过not、or及and进行组合</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="8-带括号模式">8. 带括号模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可在任何模式两边加上括号</li>
<li>用来强调或更改 逻辑模式中的优先级</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="9-列表模式">9. 列表模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>测试元素序列是否与相应的嵌套模式匹配</li>
<li>用于数组和集合类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="10-切片模式">10. 切片模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>切片模式只能显示在列表模式中,不能单独使用</li>
<li>切片模匹配一个子列表</li>
<li>切片模式中可以嵌套子模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="11-属性模式">11. 属性模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>测试表达式的属性或字段是否与嵌套模式匹配</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="12-位置模式">12. 位置模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>解构表达式结果并测试结果是否与嵌套模式匹配</li>
<li>用于元组、record类型或其他定义了Deconstruct的类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>其中逻辑模式、列表模式、属性模式和位置模式是可嵌套其他模式的复杂模式</p>
<h2 id="三-在-c-中以下场景支持模式匹配">三、 在 C# 中以下场景支持模式匹配：</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>is 表达式</li>
<li>switch 语句</li>
<li>switch 表达式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="四简单的模式匹配">四、简单的模式匹配</h2>
<h3 id="1-类型模式-1">1. 类型模式</h3>
<h4 id="11-类型模式的case">1.1 类型模式的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">if(fruit is Apple)
	return "I like Apple!";
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-easysyntax语法实现">1.2 EasySyntax语法实现</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用IsType扩展方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var fruit = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("fruit");
var appleType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Apple");
var statement = fruit.IsType(appleType)
    .If()
        .Add(SyntaxGenerator.Literal("I like Apple!").Return())
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="13-roslyn原始语法">1.3 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.TypePattern构造类型模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var fruit = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("fruit");
var appleType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Apple");
var statement = SyntaxFactory.IfStatement(
    SyntaxFactory.IsPatternExpression(fruit, 
        SyntaxFactory.TypePattern(appleType)), 
    SyntaxFactory.ReturnStatement(SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.StringLiteralExpression, 
        SyntaxFactory.Literal("I like Apple!"))));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="14-参看官方阅读">1.4 参看官方阅读</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#declaration-and-type-patterns" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#declaration-and-type-patterns</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-声明模式-1">2. 声明模式</h3>
<h4 id="21-声明模式的case">2.1 声明模式的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">if (fruit is Apple apple)
    MakeApplePie(apple);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-easysyntax-语法实现">2.2 EasySyntax 语法实现</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用VariablePattern扩展方法构造声明模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var fruit = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("fruit");
var appleType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Apple");
var apple = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("apple");
var makeApplePieMethod = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("MakeApplePie");
var statement = fruit.Is(appleType.VariablePattern(apple.Identifier))
    .If()
        .AddPatter(makeApplePieMethod.Invocation([apple]))
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="23-roslyn原始语法">2.3 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.DeclarationPattern构造声明模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var fruit = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("fruit");
var appleType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Apple");
var apple = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("apple");
var makeApplePieMethod = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("MakeApplePie");
var statement = SyntaxFactory.IfStatement(
    SyntaxFactory.IsPatternExpression(fruit, 
        SyntaxFactory.DeclarationPattern(appleType, SyntaxFactory.SingleVariableDesignation(apple.Identifier))),
    SyntaxFactory.ExpressionStatement(
        SyntaxFactory.InvocationExpression(makeApplePieMethod, 
            SyntaxFactory.ArgumentList(SyntaxFactory.SingletonSeparatedList(SyntaxFactory.Argument(apple))))));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="24-参看官方阅读">2.4 参看官方阅读</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#declaration-and-type-patterns" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#declaration-and-type-patterns</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-常量模式-1">3. 常量模式</h3>
<h4 id="31-常量模式的case">3.1 常量模式的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">obj is null
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-easysyntax-语法实现">3.2 EasySyntax 语法实现</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用ToPattern扩展方法把表达式转化为常量模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var obj = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("obj");
var expression = obj.Is(SyntaxGenerator.NullLiteral.ToPattern();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="33-roslyn原始语法">3.3 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.ConstantPattern把表达式转化为常量模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var obj = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("obj");
var expression = SyntaxFactory.IsPatternExpression(obj, 
    SyntaxFactory.ConstantPattern(
        SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NullLiteralExpression)));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="34-参看官方阅读">3.4 参看官方阅读</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#constant-pattern" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#constant-pattern</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="4-关系模式-1">4. 关系模式</h3>
<h4 id="41-关系模式的case">4.1 关系模式的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">!= 3
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-easysyntax-语法实现">4.2 EasySyntax 语法实现</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GreaterThanPattern扩展方法</li>
<li>GreaterOrEqualPattern扩展方法</li>
<li>LessThanPattern扩展方法</li>
<li>LessOrEqualPattern扩展方法</li>
<li>EqualPattern扩展方法</li>
<li>NotEqualPattern扩展方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp"> var pattern = SyntaxGenerator.NotEqualPattern(3);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="43-roslyn原始语法">4.3 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.RelationalPattern构造关系模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var pattern = SyntaxFactory.RelationalPattern(
    SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.ExclamationEqualsToken),
    SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(
        SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression,
        SyntaxFactory.Literal(3)));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="44-参看官方阅读">4.4 参看官方阅读</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#relational-patterns" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#relational-patterns</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="5-var模式-1">5. var模式</h3>
<h4 id="51-var模式的case">5.1 var模式的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">GetScores(id) is var scores &amp;&amp; scores.Average() &gt;= 60
</code></pre>
<h4 id="52-easysyntax-语法实现">5.2 EasySyntax 语法实现</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern构造var模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var getScoresMethod = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("GetScores");
var scores = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("scores");
var id = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("id");
var expression = getScoresMethod.Invocation([id])
    .Is(SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern(scores.Identifier))
    .LogicalAnd(scores.Access("Average").Invocation().GreaterOrEqual(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(60)));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="53-roslyn原始语法">5.3 Roslyn原始语法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.VarPattern构造var模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var getScoresMethod = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("GetScores");
var scores = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("scores");
var id = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("id");
var expression0 = SyntaxFactory.BinaryExpression(SyntaxKind.LogicalAndExpression, 
    SyntaxFactory.IsPatternExpression(
        SyntaxFactory.InvocationExpression(getScoresMethod, SyntaxFactory.ArgumentList(SyntaxFactory.SingletonSeparatedList(
            SyntaxFactory.Argument(id)))), 
        SyntaxFactory.VarPattern(SyntaxFactory.SingleVariableDesignation(scores.Identifier))),
    SyntaxFactory.BinaryExpression(SyntaxKind.GreaterThanOrEqualExpression,
        SyntaxFactory.InvocationExpression(
            SyntaxFactory.MemberAccessExpression(SyntaxKind.SimpleMemberAccessExpression, 
                scores, 
                SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Average"))), 
        SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression, 
            SyntaxFactory.Literal(60))));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="54-参看官方阅读">5.4 参看官方阅读</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#var-pattern" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#var-pattern</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="6-丢弃模式-1">6. 丢弃模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>丢弃模式常用于switch表达式</li>
<li>也可用于列表和位置模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="61-丢弃模式的case">6.1 丢弃模式的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">date.Day switch
{
    15 =&gt; "今夜是月圆之夜",
    _ =&gt; "月圆要等到十五"
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="62-roslyn原始语法">6.2 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.DiscardPattern()声明丢弃模式</li>
<li>以下case结合了EasySyntax的SwitchExpression语法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var date = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("date");
var expression = date.Access("Day")
    .SwitchExpression()
        .Case(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(15), SyntaxGenerator.Literal("今夜是月圆之夜"))
        .Case(SyntaxFactory.DiscardPattern(), SyntaxGenerator.Literal("月圆要等到十五"))
    .Switch.Build();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="63-easysyntax语法可以进一步简化">6.3 EasySyntax语法可以进一步简化</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SwitchExpression中的Default封装了SyntaxFactory.DiscardPattern()</li>
<li>Default是最后一个分支,可以安全的直接Build</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var date = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("date");
var expression = date.Access("Day")
    .SwitchExpression()
        .Case(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(15), SyntaxGenerator.Literal("今夜是月圆之夜"))
        .Default(SyntaxGenerator.Literal("月圆要等到十五"))
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="64-参看官方阅读">6.4 参看官方阅读</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#discard-pattern" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#discard-pattern</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="五逻辑模式">五、逻辑模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>逻辑模式嵌套了其他模式</li>
<li>逻辑模式通过and、or及not组装其他模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-逻辑模式的case">1. 逻辑模式的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该Case通过and组装了两个关系模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">0 and &lt; 10
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-easysyntax-语法实现">2. EasySyntax 语法实现</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>And扩展方法</li>
<li>Or扩展方法</li>
<li>Not扩展方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var pattern = SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0)
    .And(SyntaxGenerator.LessThanPattern(10));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-roslyn原始语法">3. Roslyn原始语法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.BinaryPattern构造逻辑模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var pattern = SyntaxFactory.BinaryPattern(SyntaxKind.AndPattern,
    SyntaxFactory.RelationalPattern(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.GreaterThanToken),
        SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression,
            SyntaxFactory.Literal(0))),
    SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.AndKeyword),
    SyntaxFactory.RelationalPattern(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.LessThanToken),
        SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression,
            SyntaxFactory.Literal(10))));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-参看官方阅读">4. 参看官方阅读</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#logical-patterns" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#logical-patterns</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="六带括号模式">六、带括号模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可在任何模式两边加上括号</li>
<li>用来强调或更改逻辑模式中的优先级</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-带括号模式的case">1 带括号模式的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该Case通过and组装了两个关系模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">input is not (float or double)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-easysyntax-语法实现-1">2 EasySyntax 语法实现</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用Parenthesized扩展方法转化为带括号模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var input = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("input");
var pattern = SyntaxFactory.TypePattern(SyntaxGenerator.FloatType)
    .Or(SyntaxFactory.TypePattern(SyntaxGenerator.DoubleType))
    .Parenthesized()
    .Not();
var expression = input.Is(pattern);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-roslyn原始语法-1">3 Roslyn原始语法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.ParenthesizedPattern构造带括号模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var input = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("input");
var pattern = SyntaxFactory.UnaryPattern(
    SyntaxFactory.ParenthesizedPattern(
        SyntaxFactory.BinaryPattern(
            SyntaxKind.OrPattern, 
            SyntaxFactory.TypePattern(
                SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.FloatKeyword))), 
            SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.OrKeyword), 
            SyntaxFactory.TypePattern(
                SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.DoubleKeyword))))));
var expression = SyntaxFactory.IsPatternExpression(input, pattern);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-参看官方阅读-1">4. 参看官方阅读</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#parenthesized-pattern" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#parenthesized-pattern</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="七列表模式">七、列表模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>测试元素序列是否与相应的嵌套模式匹配</li>
<li>用于字符串、数组和集合类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1列表模式的case">1.列表模式的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该Case由3个模式组成</li>
<li>前两个是常量模式</li>
<li>第三个是丢弃模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">name is ['曾', '国', _ ]
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2easysyntax语法实现">2.EasySyntax语法实现</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用ListPatternBuilder组装多个模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var name = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("name");
var pattern = new ListPatternBuilder()
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.Literal('曾'))
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.Literal('国'))
    .Add(SyntaxFactory.DiscardPattern())
    .Build();
var expression = name.Is(pattern);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3roslyn原始语法">3.Roslyn原始语法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.ListPattern构造列表模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var name = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("name");
var pattern = SyntaxFactory.ListPattern(SyntaxFactory.SeparatedList&lt;PatternSyntax&gt;([
    SyntaxFactory.ConstantPattern(SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.CharacterLiteralExpression, 
        SyntaxFactory.Literal('曾'))),
    SyntaxFactory.ConstantPattern(SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.CharacterLiteralExpression, 
        SyntaxFactory.Literal('国'))),
    SyntaxFactory.DiscardPattern()]));
var expression = name.Is(pattern);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-参看官方阅读-2">4. 参看官方阅读</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#list-patterns" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#list-patterns</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="八切片模式">八、切片模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>切片模式只能显示在列表模式中,不能单独使用</li>
<li>切片模匹配一个子列表</li>
<li>切片模式中可以嵌套子模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1切片模式的case">1.切片模式的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>其中.. var middle就是切片模式</li>
<li>该Case定义了一个使用切片模式和列表模式实现的回文算法</li>
<li>通过模式提取首字母、尾字母和中间切片</li>
<li>如果首尾字母相同再用中间切片递归调用该算法</li>
<li>非常简洁高效</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">static bool IsPalindrome(ReadOnlySpan&lt;char&gt; input)
    =&gt; input is not [var first, .. var middle, var last] || (first == last &amp;&amp; IsPalindrome(middle));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2easysyntax语法实现-1">2.EasySyntax语法实现</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用Slice扩展方法定义切片模式</li>
<li>用于把原模式转化为切片模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var input = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("input");
var inputType = SyntaxGenerator.Generic("ReadOnlySpan", SyntaxGenerator.CharType);
var isPalindromeMethod = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("IsPalindrome");
var first = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("first");
var middle = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("middle");
var last = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("last");
var middleSlice = SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern(middle.Identifier)
    .Slice();
var pattern = new ListPatternBuilder()
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern(first.Identifier))
    .Add(middleSlice)
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern(last.Identifier))
    .Build();
var expression1 = input.Is(pattern.Not());
var expression2 = first.Equal(last).LogicalAnd(isPalindromeMethod.Invocation([middle]));
var body = expression1.LogicalOr(expression2.Parenthesized());
var method = SyntaxGenerator.BoolType.Method(isPalindromeMethod.Identifier, inputType.Parameter(input.Identifier))
    .Static()
    .WithExpressionBody(body);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3roslyn原始语法实现切片模式">3.Roslyn原始语法实现切片模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.SlicePattern构造切片模式</li>
<li>以下代码等效EasySyntax语法的SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern(middle.Identifier).Slice()</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxFactory.SlicePattern(SyntaxGenerator.VarPattern(middle.Identifier));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-参看官方阅读-3">4. 参看官方阅读</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#list-patterns" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#list-patterns</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="九属性模式">九、属性模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由属性名(或字段名)及其模式组成</li>
<li>可以同时定义多个属性(或字段)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1属性模式的case">1.属性模式的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该Case包含了两个属性</li>
<li>Month使用常量模式</li>
<li>Day使用关系模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">{ Month: 10, Day: &lt;= 7 }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2easysyntax语法实现-2">2.EasySyntax语法实现</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用PropertyPatternBuilder组装多个属性(或字段)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var nationalDays = new PropertyPatternBuilder(null)
    .Add("Month", SyntaxGenerator.Literal(10))
    .Add("Day", SyntaxGenerator.LessOrEqualPattern(7))
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3roslyn原始语法-1">3.Roslyn原始语法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.RecursivePattern构造属性模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var nationalDays = SyntaxFactory.RecursivePattern(
    null, 
    null, 
    SyntaxFactory.PropertyPatternClause(SyntaxFactory.SeparatedList([
        SyntaxFactory.Subpattern(
            SyntaxFactory.NameColon("Month"), 
            SyntaxFactory.ConstantPattern(SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression, 
                SyntaxFactory.Literal(10)))),
        SyntaxFactory.Subpattern(
            SyntaxFactory.NameColon("Day"), 
            SyntaxFactory.RelationalPattern(
                SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.LessThanEqualsToken), 
                SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression, 
                    SyntaxFactory.Literal(7))))])),
    null);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-属性模式可选参数">4. 属性模式可选参数</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可以定义一个可选的类型参数,相当于类型模式</li>
<li>还可以定义一个可选的变量名,相当于声明模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="41-easysyntax的case">4.1 EasySyntax的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该case的类型参数为Food</li>
<li>该case的变量名为food</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var thing = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("thing");
var food = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("food");
var foodType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Food");
var now = SyntaxGenerator.DateTimeType.Access("Now");
var pattern = new PropertyPatternBuilder(foodType, food.Identifier)
     .Add("ExpirationDate", SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(now))
     .Build();
var method = foodType.Nullable().Method("FindFoot", SyntaxGenerator.ObjectType.Parameter(thing.Identifier))
    .ToBuilder()
    .If(thing.Is(pattern))
    .Return(food)
    .Return(SyntaxGenerator.NullLiteral);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-该case生成以下代码">4.2 该Case生成以下代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该Case描述一个查找食物的场景</li>
<li>先确认该东西是否为食物</li>
<li>再确认是否在保质期内</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">Food? FindFoot(object thing)
{
    if (thing is Food { ExpirationDate: &gt; DateTime.Now } food)
        return food;
    return null;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-参看官方阅读">5. 参看官方阅读</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#property-pattern" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#property-pattern</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="十位置模式">十、位置模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>解构表达式结果并测试结果是否与嵌套模式匹配</li>
<li>用于元组、record类型或其他定义了Deconstruct的类型</li>
<li>位置模式功能很强大也比较复杂</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1位置模式的简单case">1.位置模式的简单Case</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">point is (0, 0)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2easysyntax语法实现-3">2.EasySyntax语法实现</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用PropertyPatternBuilder组装多个属性(或字段)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var point = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("point");
var pattern = new PositionalPatternBuilder(null)
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(0))
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(0))
    .Build();
var isOrigin = point.Is(pattern);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3roslyn原始语法-2">3.Roslyn原始语法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.RecursivePattern构造位置模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var nationalDays = SyntaxFactory.RecursivePattern(
    null, 
    null, 
    SyntaxFactory.PropertyPatternClause(SyntaxFactory.SeparatedList([
        SyntaxFactory.Subpattern(
            SyntaxFactory.NameColon("Month"), 
            SyntaxFactory.ConstantPattern(SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression, 
                SyntaxFactory.Literal(10)))),
        SyntaxFactory.Subpattern(
            SyntaxFactory.NameColon("Day"), 
            SyntaxFactory.RelationalPattern(
                SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.LessThanEqualsToken), 
                SyntaxFactory.LiteralExpression(SyntaxKind.NumericLiteralExpression, 
                    SyntaxFactory.Literal(7))))])),
    null);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-位置模式可选参数">4. 位置模式可选参数</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可以定义一个可选的type(类型参数),相当于类型模式</li>
<li>还可以定义一个可选的name(变量名),相当于声明模式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="41-easysyntax的case-1">4.1 EasySyntax的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该case的类型参数为Point2D和Point3D</li>
<li>该case的变量名为p</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var point2DType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Point2D");
var point3DType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Point3D");
var point = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("point");
var p = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("p");
var pattern1 = new PositionalPatternBuilder(point2DType, p.Identifier)
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0))
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0))
    .Build();
var pattern2 = new PositionalPatternBuilder(point3DType, p.Identifier)
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0))
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0))
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0))
    .Build();
var body = point.SwitchExpression()
    .Case(pattern1, p.Access("ToString").Invocation())
    .Case(pattern2, p.Access("ToString").Invocation())
    .Default(SyntaxGenerator.StringType.Access("Empty"))
    .Build();
var method = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.Method("PrintIfAllCoordinatesArePositive",
        SyntaxGenerator.ObjectType.Parameter(point.Identifier))
            .WithExpressionBody(body);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-该case生成以下代码-1">4.2 该Case生成以下代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>如果是二维的点且每个坐标值都大于0</li>
<li>或者是三维的点且每个坐标值都大于0</li>
<li>否则返回空</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">string PrintIfAllCoordinatesArePositive(object point) =&gt; point switch
{
    Point2D(&gt; 0, &gt; 0) p =&gt; p.ToString(),
    Point3D(&gt; 0, &gt; 0, &gt; 0) p =&gt; p.ToString(),
    _ =&gt; string.Empty
};
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-位置模式支持属性名">5. 位置模式支持属性名</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>增加属性名能提高代码的可读性</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="51-easysyntax的case">5.1 EasySyntax的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用NamedPositionalPatternBuilder来支持属性名</li>
<li>NamedPositionalPatternBuilder也支持type和name可选参数</li>
<li>使用NamedPositionalPatternBuilder也可以轻松重写4.的Case,限与篇幅就不举例了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var point = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("point");
var pattern = new NamedPositionalPatternBuilder(null)
    .Add("X", SyntaxGenerator.Literal(0))
    .Add("Y", SyntaxGenerator.Literal(0))
    .Build();
var isOrigin = point.Is(pattern);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="52-该case生成以下代码">5.2 该Case生成以下代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>增加属性名X和Y使得代码可读性明显的提高</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">point is (X: 0, Y: 0)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="6-位置模式还可以附加属性模式">6. 位置模式还可以附加属性模式</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>不是嵌套,是属性模式作为位置模式的可选参数</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="61-例如以下代码">6.1 例如以下代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>WeightedPoint是结构体,另外还有一个属性Weight</li>
<li>Weight属性不能通过解构函数提取</li>
<li>这种情况需要特殊的位置模式来匹配</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record WeightedPoint(int X, int Y)
{
    public int Weight { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="62-easysyntax的case">6.2 EasySyntax的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用RecursivePatternBuilder来定义含属性模式的位置模式</li>
<li>RecursivePatternBuilder也支持type和name可选参数</li>
<li>NamedRecursivePatternBuilder能实现位置参数属性名表示及属性模式,限与篇幅本文不展开</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var point = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("point");
var builder = new RecursivePatternBuilder(null);
builder.Positional.Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterOrEqualPattern(0))
    .Add(SyntaxGenerator.GreaterOrEqualPattern(0));
builder.Property.Add("Weight", SyntaxGenerator.GreaterThanPattern(0));
var isInDomain = point.Is(builder.Build());
</code></pre>
<h4 id="63-该case生成以下代码">6.3 该Case生成以下代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">point is (&gt;= 0, &gt;= 0) { Weight: &gt; 0 }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="7-参看官方阅读">7. 参看官方阅读</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#positional-pattern" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/operators/patterns#positional-pattern</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
